title: GTA 6 Streaming Record: 6.38M Viewers at Once, Says IGN
description: GTA 6 streaming record: the game hit 6.38 million concurrent viewers on Twitch, YouTube and Kick, nearly four times Valorant's closed beta mark, per IGN.

body.text: The GTA 6 streaming record is here before the game has even been out for a full day. According to IGN, citing StreamCharts, GTA 6 passed 6.38 million concurrent viewers across Twitch, YouTube and Kick as of 12:30 UTC. That is nearly four times the previous record holder, Valorant's closed beta. For creators, esports fans and anyone who watches games for a living or for fun, it is a sign of how big this launch is.
How GTA 6 broke the streaming record

StreamCharts says the surge followed the game's release in New Zealand. Streamers in the United States started playing in the early hours of the morning, thanks to loopholes on Xbox that let them get a head start, according to IGN.
The 6.38 million figure combines viewership across three platforms: Twitch, YouTube and Kick. It is a concurrent number, meaning people watching at the same moment, not total views over time.
Twitch shared some of its internal data with IGN. GTA 5 has racked up 9 billion hours watched across its entire lifetime on the platform, which puts it among the most-watched games there.

IGN expects GTA 6 to get at least one or two more big viewership boosts. Two likely triggers are a rumoured PC release early next year and the online mode, which is expected sometime in 2027. Both are unconfirmed in the report, but each would be a major event in its own right.
IGN gave GTA 6 a 10/10 and called it unmatched in depth, quality and detail. The game is currently the highest-rated in history on Metacritic, with an average score of 99.
From IGN's review: it calls the game "the single most impressive video game I have ever played."
IGN spoke to several content creators about how long GTA 6 will stay relevant. Opinions are split:

items: Some streamers think the game will only be lucrative for a couple of weeks.
Others see potential for it to be mined for months and years.

body.text: Watch whether viewership holds once the launch rush fades, and whether the record gets pushed again by the rumoured PC version and the 2027 online mode. For Indian viewers and creators, the real test will be whether GTA 6 content stays a staple on streams beyond the first few weeks.

faqs.a: IGN says the game is rumoured to come to PC early next year, and its online mode is expected sometime in 2027. Neither has been confirmed in the report.
